ENVIRONMENT.description: Runtime environment flag read by bracket.config.

API_PREFIX.description: Prefix under which API routes are mounted. Must match the frontend build-time VITE_API_BASE_URL.

SERVE_FRONTEND.description: Let the backend serve the built SPA from /app/frontend-dist.

AUTO_RUN_MIGRATIONS.description: Let the app run Alembic on boot. On an empty DB the app creates tables via SQLAlchemy and stamps head (see backend/bracket/utils/db_init.py); on existing DBs alembic upgrades incrementally.

ALLOW_USER_REGISTRATION.description: Set to false to prevent public signups. Change to true if you want open registration.

FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS.description: Trust X-Forwarded-* from Heroku's router so HTTPS is detected correctly.

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign JWTs. Rotate periodically.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email of the initial admin user, created on first boot if the DB is empty.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the initial admin user. Rotate after first login.

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins, e.g. https://bracket-prod.herokuapp.com. Never leave as '*' in production.

BASE_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of the app, used for SSO callbacks and similar.

SENTRY_DSN.description: Optional Sentry DSN for error reporting.
